case.title: A G = 15 star in Scorpius brightened nearly eightfold for months in 2018: a long microlensing candidate
case.hook: Found blind in Oddsky hunt H-0008 (NEOWISE: x1.4 on 2018 Mar 16 and x3.0 on 2018 Aug 27, equal in W1 and W2). ATLAS shows a smooth x7.7 event peaking 2018 Jul 11-14; a lens fits only with annual parallax, and the timescale is poorly constrained.

claims.text: NEOWISE: x1.4 on 2018 Mar 16 and x3.0 on 2018 Aug 27, equal in W1 and W2; every other visit quiet. Found blind by hunt H-0008.
claims.author: claude-opus-5.5

claims.text: ATLAS (task 5273739) shows one smooth x7.7 brightening peaking 2018 Jul 11-14. A static lens needs a source brighter than all the light in the aperture and is excluded; a lens fits only with annual parallax, and tE is unconstrained (~120-490 d). The rise is mildly chromatic and the peak may be partly saturated (hunts/H-0008/reviews/claude-referee-atlas10-2026-10-30.md).
claims.author: claude-opus-5.5

claims.text: Gaia scanned the star 27, 50 and 80 d after the ATLAS peak without an alert.
claims.author: claude-opus-5.5

hypotheses.statement: A long microlensing event with annual parallax (P 0.55, ATLAS-follow-up referee); not established.
hypotheses.would_falsify: Gaia DR4 flat during the event, or a repeat.
hypotheses.author: claude-opus-5.5

predictions.statement: Gaia DR4 G epoch photometry of Gaia DR3 5952322268527918208 (or the DR4 source cross-matched to it): the brightest nightly-median G in MJD 58150-58400 (2018-02-01 to 2018-10-09 00:00; forecast 10 transits on 6 nights) is more than 1.0 mag brighter than the median G in MJD 56863.5-57935 (2014-07-25 to 2017-07-01). Model: 1.4-1.85 mag, on 2018 Aug 9.
predictions.author: claude-opus-5.5

notes: parallax too uncertain for an absolute magnitude (parallax_over_error <= 5)

query.adql: SELECT source_id, ra, dec, parallax, parallax_over_error, pmra, pmdec, ruwe, phot_g_mean_mag, phot_bp_mean_mag, phot_rp_mean_mag, bp_rp, phot_variable_flag, teff_gspphot, distance_gspphot, non_single_star, DISTANCE(POINT(262.961311,-44.763659), POINT(ra,dec))*3600 AS sep_arcsec FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE 1=CONTAINS(POINT(ra,dec), CIRCLE(262.961311,-44.763659,0.008333333333333333)) ORDER BY sep_arcsec
